title: Rapid Setup Catalyst - Hero and Flow Widgets for Onboarding Landing
creator: Lena Park
description: Design a compact, high-clarity hero and a set of interactive flow widgets for the Rapid Setup (Quickstart) landing page that scale from mobile to desktop. The goal is to reduce cognitive load for new users, increase activation rate on the Quickstart path, and provide assets that engineering can implement without multiple visual rounds. Deliverables include hero art (3 density variants), 4 step-diagram templates (static + animated Lottie-ready), a modular screenshot system for 3 product flows, copy overlays, and accessibility specs (contrast, alt text guidelines, keyboard focus states).
acceptance_criteria: Hero has three density variants: Minimal, Guided, and Explore; each exported at @1x @2x @3x and responsive breakpoints
Four step-diagram templates completed: Linear ladder, Timeline strip, Card mosaic, and Conversational flow; each with static PNG/SVG and Lottie JSON placeholders
Screenshot system includes automated masks and device frames for Desktop, Tablet, Mobile with sample overlays for: API key creation, Sample request, Console monitoring
Figma file contains developer-facing frames with tokens, spacing, and export slices; handoff doc with CSS snippets and asset naming guidelines included
Accessibility checklist signed off by UX researcher: color contrast >=4.5:1 for body text in hero, all images with approved alt text, keyboard-focus patterns documented
Implementation estimate from frontend engineering provided and no major visual blockers remain in code review
